AUTH::abort
Description
Cancels any outstanding auth operations in this authentication
session, and generates an
AUTH_FAILURE
event if there was an
outstanding authentication query in progress. This command invalidates
the specified authentication session ID, which should be discarded
upon calling this command.
Syntax
AUTH
::
abort
authid
AUTH::abort authid
Cancels any outstanding auth operations in this authentication
session, and generates an ‘’’AUTH_FAILURE* event if there was an
outstanding authentication query in progress. This command
invalidates the specified authentication session authentication ID,
which should be discarded upon calling this command.
Examples
This rule demonstrates one possible implementation of a 2-out-of-3
authentication scheme. 3 auth servers are contacted simultaneously.
The connection is permitted to proceed as soon as 2 servers report
success.
